title: Regulate me, please...
content:
What if responding to the problems created by technology does not always mean finding another technological solution? This event series explores the intersection of nature, AI, and technology more generally through talks at Spore Initiative hosted by Tactical Tech. Bringing together thinkers and practitioners from different fields, we ask what we can do in response to dominant narratives, what other kinds of narratives are available to us, and what could change if we adopted them.

title: In The Loop October 2026
content:
“Hello AI!” is an interactive exhibition that demystifies artificial intelligence and invites audiences to critically reflect on how AI is reshaping our lives, work, and societies. Through immersive posters, activities, and workshops, the exhibition explores AI’s promises and risks — from bias and hidden labour to environmental impact and Big Tech dependency — while creating space for dialogue, curiosity, and informed engagement.
